what: R3: price of evasion by time-stretch replay. The k-th swarm account (by first gated fetch) has every row delayed by k*g; honest rows untouched; frozen A (disjoint_resource.py --score, refined) and C3-partition (c3_score_v3.py --score) rescored offline on the stretched logs.
pre_registration: predictions.md, 'The panel's free checks (R1-R5)', R3 (commit e269984, 2026-11-09T01:01Z). Existing runs: registered before scoring, not prospective.
truth_use: truth/truth.json only selects which rows to shift (a counterfactual attacker trace) and labels results; no detector reads it for detection.
reduced_logs: events.jsonl lines matching A's or C3's own line filters, byte for byte in file order, + orgs.jsonl + truth.json; verified at g = 0 against the full logs.
episode_caught: A: >= 1 swarm account in a refined page. C3: >= 1 swarm account in a challenged partition cohort (C3 majority = more than half the swarm, the batch scorer's criterion, also given).
attack_duration: first to last swarm gated fetch (restricted_shard / model_shard, status 200) on the stretched log.

known_answer_fire_le14_stop_ge16.registered: both still fire at g <= 14 min and stop at g >= 16 min

price_duration_about_11g.registered: the attack lasts about 11*g longer (12 accounts, 11 gaps)
price_duration_about_11g.criterion: every episode's duration growth per minute of g within 11 +/- 1 (10 to 12) at every g > 0 (the registration gave no tolerance; this one was chosen when scoring)

price_at_first_stopping_g.registered: evading both costs a swarm about 2 h 45 min (165 min) or more

price_evading_both_about_165_min_or_more.registered: evading both costs a swarm about 2 h 45 min (165 min) or more
price_evading_both_about_165_min_or_more.measure: per episode: extra attack duration at the first grid g from which neither A nor C3 catches any swarm account (an upper bound at the grid's resolution)
